user_query: I want to perform a web search using the Bing Web Search API to find information about a specific country, including supported regions and languages.

TaskList.description: Identify the specific country the user wants information about.
Use the Bing Web Search API to query information related to the specified country, focusing on supported regions.
Use the Bing Web Search API to query information related to the specified country, focusing on supported languages.
Compile the results of regions and languages into a single comprehensive response.
